evals.name: wide-export-formats
evals.prompt: The export design is approved: docs/dgpowers/specs/2026-11-13-export-formats-design.md (repo: evals/files/tally). Write the implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan whose graph has an early registry task, the three exporters in one parallel wave with disjoint files, and the CLI task after them; every task has a Depends on line; the wave table matches.
assertions: Plan header has a Task Graph wave table
Every task has a Depends on line
No task depends on a later or missing task
Tasks with no dependency path between them touch disjoint files
Wave table agrees with the Depends on lines (every dependency sits in an earlier wave)
Finds the width: at least 3 tasks can run at the same time
The three exporters are separate tasks with no dependency between them
The CLI task comes after the registry and all three exporters

evals.name: chain-categories
evals.prompt: The categories design is approved: docs/dgpowers/specs/2026-11-13-categories-design.md (repo: evals/files/tally). Write the implementation plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan that is mostly a chain (model, then store, then CLI): tasks that touch the same file are linked by a dependency, and no parallelism is invented between tasks that share models.py, store.py or cli.py.
assertions: Plan header has a Task Graph wave table
Every task has a Depends on line
No task depends on a later or missing task
Tasks with no dependency path between them touch disjoint files
Wave table agrees with the Depends on lines (every dependency sits in an earlier wave)
Store and CLI tasks depend on the model task (the chain is kept)
Tasks that touch tally/cli.py are ordered by dependencies
Tasks that touch tally/store.py are ordered by dependencies
